Chinese Original: 一直用手機拍照，直到朋友借我一台全幅機去街拍一下午。
English Translation: I kept taking photos with my phone until a friend lent me a full-frame camera for an afternoon of street photography.

Chinese Original: 對焦速度和夜拍的乾淨程度讓我回不去。
English Translation: The fast autofocus speed and clean night shots made me unable to return to my phone camera.

Chinese Original: 隔週就下訂了同款的二手機身，鏡頭先買一顆定焦。
English Translation: A week later, I ordered a second-hand body of the same model and bought a prime lens first.
